name: Trouble Chaser Dai 3 Wa - 2 Do Aru Trouble 3 Do Aru
original_name: トラぶるＣＨＡＳＥＲ 第３話 ２度あるトラブル３度ある
source:
New chaser girl Ridia lands near Daisuke house. How will Rudy and Rena react? And what's the truth behind the identity of a mysterious person Ridia was chasing?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/07/vn-of-month-june-1995.html]vndbreview[/url]]

新來的追擊者少女莉迪婭降落在大輔家附近。露蒂和蕾娜會作何反應？莉迪婭一直追趕的神秘人物，其真實身分又究竟是什麼？
